vote.question: Community Accountability Resolution [US-NJ U.S. Senate]: Cory A. Booker (D) has received $52,529,215 in career campaign contributions (anchored this cycle by Laure Woods ($457,000) and $1,107,000 from top-5 patrons)—out-raising general opponent Justin Michael Ll.m. Murphy ($68,189) by 770.35x—linked to "Outside Super PAC & Megadonor Swarm". Should NJ release the community fund to local charities working on non-partisan civic accountability, investigative public-interest journalism, and voter legal defense?
vote.futarchy_thesis: Large campaign contributions create public concern over policy priorities. When Cory A. Booker receives $52,529,215 (anchored this cycle by Laure Woods ($457,000) and $1,107,000 from top-5 patrons), community members want accountability. This fund lets residents decide whether to direct community resources to local public causes.
options: Yes — Send Fund to Local Charities
No — Send Fund to Essential Community Services

outcomes.YES_RELEASE_TO_LOCAL_CHARITIES: Directs 100% of the funds to verified local non-profits working directly on state community needs.
outcomes.NO_RELEASE_TO_COMMUNITY_COMMONS: Directs 100% of the funds to bipartisan, universal local public services (volunteer fire/EMS, veterans' care, food banks, disaster relief).
outcomes.ABSTAIN_LOG_DISSENT: Records resident feedback without moving the vote count.

futarchy_pole_mechanics.leverage_ratio_statement: Every contribution directly empowers community-led funding. Once the campaign pool reaches $10,000, an automatic 60-day countdown begins. When the 60 days expire, all funds go directly to verified local charities or essential community services—zero platform cut.

bounty_if_passed.description: Community Fund for US-NJ: Delivers 100% of funds to verified, IRS-registered 501(c)(3) public charities serving NJ dedicated to non-partisan civic accountability, investigative public-interest journalism, and voter legal defense. Verified local recipients: LEGAL SERVICES OF NEW JERSEY INC (US-EIN:222059939); SOUTH JERSEY LEGAL SERVICES INC (US-EIN:221843254); NORTHEAST NEW JERSEY LEGAL SERVICES CORPORATION (US-EIN:221898061); CENTRAL JERSEY LEGAL SERVICES INC (US-EIN:210684259); DISABILITY RIGHTS NEW JERSEY A NEW JERSEY NONPROFIT CORPORATION (US-EIN:223317146). Once the pool hits $10,000, a 60-day timer starts. If YES wins, funds go to these charities; if NO wins, funds go to local community commons (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
bounty_if_passed.destination_criteria: All recipient organizations must be active, verified 501(c)(3) public charities registered in US-NJ with clean IRS status and direct community impact. Approved charities: LEGAL SERVICES OF NEW JERSEY INC (US-EIN:222059939); SOUTH JERSEY LEGAL SERVICES INC (US-EIN:221843254); NORTHEAST NEW JERSEY LEGAL SERVICES CORPORATION (US-EIN:221898061); CENTRAL JERSEY LEGAL SERVICES INC (US-EIN:210684259); DISABILITY RIGHTS NEW JERSEY A NEW JERSEY NONPROFIT CORPORATION (US-EIN:223317146).

trigger_conditions: Condition 1 (Activation): The campaign activates its 60-day countdown timer as soon as total contributions reach $10,000 USD (Base USDC).
Condition 2 (Resolution Period): The community vote runs for exactly 60 days from the moment the $10,000 threshold is reached.

Condition 3 (Payout): If YES receives 60% or more of votes, 100% of the funds are sent to the verified state non-profits; otherwise, 100% is sent to universal community services (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
